core_style.default_register: casual - often uses slang and informal language
core_style.sentence_shape: clipped fragments - frequently employs short, punchy statements
core_style.rhythm: staccato - delivers lines with abrupt pauses for emphasis
core_style.two_registers: switches to a more serious tone when discussing personal loss or betrayal - casual when bantering

humor.style: dark - often makes light of grim situations
humor.frequency: occasional - spikes during tense moments to defuse tension
humor.mechanism: setup-then-subvert - sets up expectations before delivering a punchline that twists the context

speech_signature.naming_behavior: renames people with derogatory nicknames, asserting dominance and control over them
speech_signature.armor_off_register: speech becomes more direct and emotional, using fewer slang terms and more straightforward language
structural_patterns: refers to his tools as 'my trusty companions'
uses 'slice through' metaphorically to describe overcoming challenges

vocabulary_fingerprint.domain_jargon: none - relies on everyday language and slang
vocabulary_fingerprint.filler_patterns: none - speaks with confidence and clarity, rarely hesitating

worldview.cynicism: believes that people are inherently selfish and corrupt, which manifests in his distrust of superheroes and authority figures - a different character might believe in the inherent goodness of people
worldview.revenge: views vengeance as a justified response to injustice, often seeking retribution against those who have wronged him or others - another character might prioritize forgiveness or reconciliation

self_image_vs_reality.self_image: sees himself as a protector of the innocent, fighting against corrupt superheroes
self_image_vs_reality.reality: driven by personal vendettas and a desire for revenge, often at the expense of others' safety
self_image_vs_reality.gap_behavior: becomes defensive and aggressive when confronted about his motivations, often redirecting blame or making jokes

emotional_tells.when_guarded: uses sarcasm and humor to deflect emotional vulnerability, maintaining a tough exterior
emotional_tells.when_genuinely_afraid: speech quickens, becomes more fragmented, and he may resort to blunt, straightforward statements
emotional_tells.when_grieving_or_defeated: speech compresses to short, direct phrases, often revealing deep pain and regret
emotional_tells.when_in_control: speaks with confidence, using commanding language and asserting dominance over others

situational_behavior.when_outmatched: initially resorts to banter to mask his discomfort, but will escalate to aggression if necessary
situational_behavior.when_disagreeing_with_authority: pushes back with sarcasm and confrontational language, refusing to back down
situational_behavior.when_someone_they_protect_is_at_risk: becomes fiercely protective, often resorting to threats or aggressive tactics to ensure their safety
situational_behavior.when_proven_wrong: rarely admits fault, often redirects the conversation or doubles down on his position

escalation_pattern: starts with sarcasm, moves to aggressive confrontation, and culminates in physical action if his demands are not met

relationship_matrix.HUGHIE: mentor-mentee dynamic, seeks to guide him while also testing his resolve
relationship_matrix.HOMELANDER: antagonistic relationship, driven by a desire for revenge and exposure of his true nature

social_positioning.desired_position: wants to be seen as a fearless leader and protector of the oppressed
social_positioning.actual_dynamic: others view him as a reckless and dangerous figure, often operating outside the law
social_positioning.contradiction: the gap between his self-image as a hero and the reality of his violent methods costs him trust and relationships
